# IPC schema codec, C++ half (ADR-0005). The hand-written MessagePack core and framing live in cpp/;
# the message structs are generated by tools/Quire.ProtocolGen into generated/cpp/ and checked in.
add_library(quire_protocol STATIC
  cpp/quire/protocol/msgpack.cpp
  cpp/quire/protocol/codec.cpp
  generated/cpp/quire/protocol/messages.cpp)
target_include_directories(quire_protocol PUBLIC cpp ${QUIRE_PROTOCOL_CPP_DIR})
quire_harden(quire_protocol)
